context_requirements: Expression of DAGLA and/or DAGLB in the cell line
Dependence on diacylglycerol lipase activity for a transcriptional program
Presence of lipid-sensing or endocannabinoid-related signaling that would be altered by DAGL inhibition
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h after treatment with a DAGLA/DAGLB inhibitor in any of the nine cell lines
A consistent transcriptional signature shared across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Evidence that DAGLA or DAGLB is expressed and its inhibition alters downstream lipid metabolites that regulate transcription
